crossRefs.note: Because he has stretched out his hand against God, and behaves himself proudly against the Almighty,
he runs at him with a stiff neck, with the thick shields of his bucklers,
They have set their mouth in the heavens. Their tongue walks through the earth.
But they will do all these things to you for my name’s sake, because they don’t know him who sent me.

translations.web: His servants spoke yet more against Yahweh God, and against his servant Hezekiah.
translations.bsb: And the servants of Sennacherib spoke further against the LORD God and against His servant Hezekiah.
translations.kjv: And his servants spake yet more against the LORD God, and against his servant Hezekiah.
translations.asv: And his servants spake yet more against Jehovah God, and against his servant Hezekiah.
